description: Reconnaissance of Wind Damage to Buildings in Downtown Houston, Texas is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Jamie Padgett, Rice University (rice.edu). This project presents field data collected related to the damage of tall and mid-rise buildings in Downtown Houston, Texas, during the severe storms on Thursday, May 16, 2024. Coverage: Houston, Texas. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: wind, tall buildings, windows, glass, damage, storm. Published 2024-05-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
